# Clean Webpage Reader

Paid x402 API for AI agents.
Returns clean main text and Markdown from a URL.

Base URL: https://clean-webpage-reader-production.up.railway.app

## Endpoints
- GET /health
  Free. Service status.

- GET /read?url={https_url}
  Paid. Extract clean text + markdown from a public webpage.

## Payment
Protocol: x402
Scheme: exact
Network: eip155:8453 (Base mainnet)
Price: $0.01 USDC per call
Pay to: 0x3FfCEdBE43De60Dcc58ebF5c737F5c47e8De59FD

If HTTP 402, read the payment-required header, pay, retry the same request.

## Example
GET https://clean-webpage-reader-production.up.railway.app/read?url=https://example.com
